$comment: Workspace modules outside the mobile trees that mobile code may import (AGL-3620). check-mobile-isolation admits each one only while its own imports are pure: listed modules, platform-neutral packages, no DOM, no Node built-in, nothing web- or server-only. The list grows only with that proof; a module that mixes pure and web code is split, never listed.
